idle.originMethod: Midpoint of both boot support extent in lowest15px above sole, excluding sword tip; no single-boot anchor.

run.worldScaleMethod: Match front head/hair alpha width to common idle adult reference. Equal-height comparison UPP is supplied separately; do not conceal source proportion differences by independent body-height normalization.
run.originMethod: X waist/belt-band longest opaque body segment centre median, no boot anchor switching; Y fixed median sole line per direction overA/B.

scaleReference.note: Head alpha includes curls. Band definitions and core body widths are explicit; shoulders include cape/pauldron silhouette. Neck-based head count is an approximate silhouette locator, not a verified anatomical jaw measure.

visualStatus: W01 small-scope candidates. Front/back A/B support sides exchanged on visual inspection; source proportion and actual camera comparison remain pending root. No runtime manifest changed.

waistlineReadings.method: Manual visual centre of horizontal belt/buckle, not hip/crotch. Coordinates are source-cell local; belt thickness gives about2px uncertainty.

requestedWorldCalibration.note: Root owns actual runtime choice. Action UPP values retain the1.8m diagnostic reference explicitly reported earlier; these requested values expose both constraints instead of concealing source head/body discrepancy.
